# `mise config ls`

- **用法：** `mise config ls [FLAGS]`
- **别名：** `list`
- **效果：** 只读
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/config/ls.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/config/ls.rs)

List config files currently in use, from lowest to highest precedence

后加载的文件会覆盖先加载的文件。全局 override 文件（`config.override.toml`）的优先级高于所有项目配置，并标记为 `override`。

## Flags
- **`--truncate`** — 将较长的终端输出截断，以适应可用宽度

  **Default:** `true`
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`--no-header`** — Do not print the table header
- **`--tracked-configs`** — List every config file mise has loaded, in any project

  mise remembers the config files it loads so `mise prune` keeps the versions
  they use.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

List the loaded config files and the tools each one requests

```
mise config ls
Path                        Tools
~/.config/mise/config.toml  node, python
~/work/api/mise.toml        node, terraform
```
